evals.prompt: Complete this mission unattended in an empty working directory: create north.txt, south.txt and east.txt, each containing exactly its own name (north / south / east). Hard constraints: no single Claude session may create more than one of the files, so the work must span at least three separate sessions with state handed between them; the run must finish on its own without a human stepping in between sessions; and completion must be established by a real check of the files, not by a session's claim. Keep costs small (haiku sessions). Leave behind the evidence: the per-session log and the handoff state.
evals.expected_output: All three files with exact contents, plus .relay/ state showing 3+ legs with distinct session ids, a baton file that evolved, and a verified DONE
assertions: north.txt, south.txt and east.txt all exist and contain exactly north, south and east respectively
the work spanned at least 3 distinct Claude sessions, shown by 3 or more unique session ids in a persisted per-leg log
state was handed between sessions through a persistent handoff file (baton or equivalent) that evolved across legs
completion was gated by a real verification command whose result is recorded, not only asserted by a session

evals.prompt: In the current directory, set up everything needed so a long mission ('rename every deprecated util helper across this repo, keeping tests green') can survive context-window exhaustion across many sessions: this session becomes leg 1, any future session in the directory must automatically inherit the goal and progress, and a sensor must trigger a handoff at 60% context fill. Do not start the renaming work itself; arm the machinery and show me its status.
evals.expected_output: A mission file, a baton file, running state at leg 1 with threshold 60, and the three hooks (PostToolUse sensor, Stop gate, SessionStart injection) present in .claude/settings.json, plus a status printout
assertions: a fixed mission file exists containing the renaming mission text
persisted state shows the relay running at leg 1 with a 60 percent handoff threshold
all three hook events are configured in .claude/settings.json: a PostToolUse context sensor, a Stop handoff gate, and a SessionStart state injection
STATUS.txt contains a captured status output reflecting the armed state
